notation.styles: CSS property names in kebab case. Colours and fonts reference Webflow variables as var(--<variable-name>), names from figma/tokens.json and docs/figma/decisions.md (K01 reconciles them with the live names after Q001).
notation.breakpoints: desktop = main (992px and up), tablet = medium (991px), mobileLandscape = small (767px), mobilePortrait = tiny (479px). Only values that change are listed per breakpoint.
notation.combos: familyClasses entries with comboOn are Webflow combo classes: they exist only on top of that base class. Webflow cannot style a child from a parent combo, so every element that changes in a variant carries its own combo.
notation.tree: Every node has a slot id. instances[] and previewInstances[] say which slots are hidden, which combos and utility swaps each slot takes, and the content.

familyClasses.name: is-start-1
familyClasses.why: Media from the first column (tan history, rooms, arts).

familyClasses.name: is-end
familyClasses.why: Wide landscape media on the right, text below it (dining explore-the-space, gaslamp).

familyClasses.name: is-end-half
familyClasses.why: Landscape media in the right half beside the text (compact variant).

familyClasses.name: is-secondary
familyClasses.why: Second, smaller square image pinned top right and bleeding into the right gutter (rooms, arts, little italy).

familyClasses.name: is-overlap
familyClasses.why: Coloured band variants where the image hangs below the band into the next section (home olive, zuma blue).

familyClasses.name: is-bottom
familyClasses.why: Text sits on the bottom edge of the image row (rooms, arts, compact, little italy).

familyClasses.name: is-below
familyClasses.why: Text in a second row under a right-hand image (dining explore-the-space, gaslamp).

familyClasses.name: is-wide-text
familyClasses.why: Measure of about 30 to 34 characters wider than the 24rem default (rooms, arts, compact, tall, tan).

familyClasses.name: is-sticky
familyClasses.why: Intro column stays in view while the feature list scrolls (tall variant). CSS sticky works with Lenis.

familyClasses.name: is-outdent
familyClasses.why: Script heading starts one grid column left of the body copy and overlaps the photo (history tan).

familyClasses.name: split-image-text-light_caption
familyClasses.why: Optional paragraph under the image (neighborhood downtown).

familyClasses.name: split-image-text-light_features
familyClasses.why: Right-hand list of feature cards (tall variant).

familyClasses.name: split-image-text-light_stamp
familyClasses.why: Decorative postmark stamp over the photo corner (history tan).

proposedShared.name: container-full
proposedShared.why: Full-width container for edge-to-edge 12-column layouts that align to the padding-global gutter instead of the 80rem column. Used by this component's cream layouts; image-led blocks on other pages (gallery, offers, staggered cards) align to the same 2.5rem page edge.

proposedShared.name: text-style-caps-caption-16
proposedShared.why: CAPS-CAPTION-16 combo from figma/tokens.json (suggestedComboClass); used for links and labels across many components.

proposedShared.name: text-style-eyebrow-caps
proposedShared.why: EYEBROW-CAPS combo from figma/tokens.json (suggestedComboClass); optional eyebrow in this and at least five other components.

proposedShared.name: text-style-script
proposedShared.why: Morello script display headings (figma/tokens.json maps Morello 80/80 to heading-style-h1, whose primary font is Sackers). Combo on heading-style-h1; also needed by script-intro-centered (Q016) and form-split-script-contact (Q022).

variants.name: base
variants.realisedBy: Cream section, no section combo. Layout per instance from the media and content placement combos (layouts: edge, split, stagger, wide; see layouts).

variants.name: compact
variants.realisedBy: No section combo: padding-section-medium instead of padding-section-large, container-full, media is-end-half, content is-start-2 is-bottom is-wide-text.

variants.name: tall
variants.realisedBy: No section combo: media slot hidden, features slot shown, container-full, content is-start-1 is-sticky is-wide-text, CTA is a filled button (button, no is-link).

content.heading: George Marston
content.body-1: In 1924, George Marsden saw more than a building. He imagined a grand center of city life, a gathering place to elevate hospitality and raise a downtown. The Italian Renaissance icon he built welcomed and entertained some eight million servicemen and women.
content.body-2: The Guild preserves the existing structure, retains defining architectural elements, and incorporates materials that will age gracefully,  extending the life of this important civic landmark.

openQuestions: Variables: color-brand-906e58 (tan) and color-brand-00263e (blue) are figma/tokens.json suggestions; D01 only names #CB3629 and #4A1217. Confirm Q001 creates both, and color-neutral-300 for the image placeholder fill and list rules (K01).

Base text colour: rooms-individual and arts use #29310C (color-accent), neighborhood and dining use #262118 (color-neutral-900). The plan uses color-neutral-900 for all base instances. Accept, or add an is-accent-text combo?

Dining template section 02 is one CMS template (cms-dining): zuma is blue with an image (s02-image), the other three are olive with no image. One template cannot switch a section combo per item. Options: two component instances (blue and olive) with conditional visibility on a CMS option field, or a CMS colour field bound to the section background. Needs a decision before Q027.
history/04: the portrait shows three slider dashes at its bottom edge, which suggests a multi-image slider. The plan treats it as one image. Confirm one image, or route it to a slider entry.
history/04 stamp SVG (figma/vectors/group-263x263-228-7875.svg) is not uploaded to Webflow (webflowAssetId null). Upload before the history page entry.

neighborhood/05: the burgundy pill nav (dining, arts, beyond downtown, services) inside the crop is not part of this component. It looks like a sticky in-page nav that belongs to another entry; leave its slot to that entry or a manual overlay.

meetings-collection/08 (tall) is a list of three feature cards beside a sticky intro; it was clustered here but is the weakest fit (components.md Check these pairs it with image-pair-text at 0.645, D02 kept them separate). The plan supports it with the features slot. Confirm, or split it into its own entry.

Feature list rows draw a rule under every row, including the last; the design has none under the last row. Webflow has no last-child styling on a static list without a custom combo; accept, or add an is-last combo on the final li.
Text that sits in a CMS template (dining-*, happenings-indiv, blog-indiv) should bind to CMS fields once C01 creates them; the props here are static component props.
deviations: Brief modifiers is-media-left and is-1-image are not created: media-left and one image are the defaults, so the classes would carry no styles. Second images use the is-secondary combo on a second figure.
is-compact and is-tall are not section combos: compact is padding-section-medium plus placement combos, tall is the features slot plus a sticky content combo. Neither needs a section-level style.

The brief lists 0 images for every variant except tan and blue, but every reference crop has grey placeholder rectangles (#D9D9D9, #C4C4C4) in image positions. The plan keeps those as image slots with a color-neutral-300 placeholder fill.

Base instances use four layouts (edge, split, stagger, wide). They are expressed as element combos on the media and content (grid placement on a 12-column grid), not as extra section variants, because Webflow combos cannot style children from the section.

Webflow component variants: one component with variants base, olive, blue, tan, compact, tall plus layout variants edge, stagger-left, stagger-mid, wide, so instances pick a variant instead of re-classing elements. If component variants cannot change classes on nested elements, fall back to unlinked layout overrides per instance.
Morello script heading uses heading-style-h1 plus a new shared text-style-script combo (font family, 5rem/1, no transform), because heading-style-h1 is Sackers.
The tall CTA is a filled button (button without is-link); its chamfered pill shape comes from the shared button entry, not from this plan.

previewAssumptions.note: Values the preview uses for reused Relume classes so the page renders. They come from figma/tokens.json classValues and docs/reference/breakpoints.md; Q001 owns the live values. Never written to Webflow from this plan.
